new_slots.name: sale value
new_slots.sentence: The jets, made by US defense contractor Lockheed Martin as part of an $8 billion sale agreed seven years ago, are equipped with advanced avionics, and radar systems to better counter the Chinese air force, including its stealthy J-20 fighters — but Washington has been unwilling to provide its most advanced fighters like the F-22 or F-35.

new_slots.name: backlog value
new_slots.sentence: The shipment is the first in a long list of backlogged U.S. orders worth almost $30 billion.

new_slots.name: F-16V value
new_slots.sentence: The F-16Vs represent $8 billion, or roughly 25% of the entire backlog, according to Taiwan Security Monitor at George Mason University.

new_slots.name: arrival date
new_slots.sentence: They landed on Friday following months of delay due to repeated requests from Beijing to the US to stop arming Taiwan.

new_slots.name: arrival time
